overview: The railway made worth building: faster track that switches itself, a handbrake for the rider, carts chained into trains, and working carts that lay track and dig.

1.1.3: A chain of TNT carts goes off as one charge and bores a corridor you can walk down.
An advancement for the first real tunnel.
Rail laid ahead spans drops and follows a climb instead of stopping.
Chained carts hold one speed along the link.
A cart with a heading wears an arrow that says which way it is pointed.
1.0.0: Speed lives in the track, and rails switch themselves.
The rider gets a handbrake, and carts couple into trains.
Three of the working carts become tools that lay track or dig.
